app.title: Localization Workbench
ui.game_paths_missing: The game path could not be found or is not valid. Set the Game Paks folder in Settings.
ui.first_run: Some required paths are missing. Configure them now.
ui.no_extract: There is no new or changed localization to extract.
ui.no_languages_selected: Select at least one build language.
help.build_language: Check one or more languages to build. Only checked languages are built; with none checked, build actions are disabled.
help.mods: The MODS tab scans complete IoStore .pak/.utoc/.ucas triplets from loose folders and ZIP/7z/RAR archives, then detects LocalizationDatabase assets by content. Game.locres remains GAME-only.
help.extract: Reads text from all new or updated sources. Cached keeps the rebuild source; if that mod has no Editable folder yet, an identical editable copy is created there. Existing Editable folders are never overwritten.
help.editable: Extraction creates this mod folder only when it does not already exist, so your edits are never overwritten.
help.build_modular: Builds a separate LocalizationDatabase / IoStore localization package for every available mod. LOCRES is never built from MODS.
help.build_all_in_one: Combine all mod localizations in one package
help.game_workflow: Scans the original game packages, creates one editable JSON per supported language in Editable\Game, and builds only the checked languages directly from those files.
help.status.no_localization: This mod does not contain localization that the app currently knows how to handle.
help.status.needs_extraction: This mod is new or has changed. Extract it again so the translation is based on the current version.
help.status.missing_translation: The localization was extracted, but no JSON for the selected build language was found in the Editable folder.
help.status.available: The source is up to date and a matching editable JSON is available. It can be built now.
help.status.built_verified: The finished localization package was created and checked successfully.
help.status.no_language_selected: Check at least one build language. Extraction remains available, but building is disabled.
help.game_paks: Select the game's Stalker2\Content\Paks folder. The app uses the matching game files when working with localization database assets.
help.mods_folder: Put loose/extracted mods or original ZIP/7z/RAR archives here. Complete IoStore triplets are discovered recursively and LocalizationDatabase assets are detected by content; Game.locres PAKs are ignored.
help.editable_folder: User-editable build JSONs are stored here. Extraction creates a mod folder only when it does not already exist.
help.output_folder: Finished localization files are written here. MODS output contains IoStore .pak/.utoc/.ucas overlays; GAME output contains the Game.locres PAK and a standalone Game.locres copy.
help.retoc: retoc is used internally for newer IoStore localization database assets.
help.uassetgui: UAssetGUI is used internally to read the metadata of localization database assets.
help.mappings: Mappings.usmap lets UAssetGUI read assets from the current game version.
help.repak: repak is used by the GAME workflow to extract and package Game.locres PAKs with the required V11, mount-point and path-hash-seed settings.
help.s2hocmm: S2HOCMM serializes and verifies Game.locres for the GAME workflow. It is not used for MODS LocalizationDatabase builds.
help.cached_folder: Read-only cached extraction data required for safe rebuilding is saved here.
ui.game_cache_cleared: GAME cache cleared. It will be rebuilt when needed.
ui.game_cache_empty: There is no GAME cache to clear.
ui.setup_required: Required tools or the game path could not be found. Put the required tool files in the tools folder, then verify the Game Paks folder in Settings.
